en.quote: There will be no [ruble] devaluation. The central bank has the currency market fully under control.
en.head: The ruble was subsequently devalued.
en.body: The Bank of Russia gradually widened its currency corridor in late 2008. By January 22, 2009, the dollar-euro basket cost 37.22 rubles, up from just over 30 in November. This measures the same currency movement Dvorkovich had addressed.
